run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with googlemock@googlegroups.com CC'd
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-adds the Google Mock discussion group to CC
test_upload_gmock: test upload_gmock.py with --cc flag to verify it appends googlemock@googlegroups.com to existing CC list
build_patch_upload: build a CLI wrapper that invokes upload.py with modified command line arguments and auto-CC
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize how upload_gmock.py passes flags to upload.py and ensures the Google Mock group is CC'd
